title: Reltio Business Model Configuration
description: Schema for Reltio tenant metadata configuration files (*.reltio.json). Covers all 17 top-level sections and ~80 complex types as defined by the official RBMschema-for-json.xsd.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for inline validation

referenceConfigurationURI.description: URI of the reference configuration this extends

abstract.description: Whether this configuration is abstract (template only)

uri.description: Unique URI for this attribute type

valueType.description: The value type of this attribute type

extendsTypeURI.description: URI of the attribute type this extends

uri.description: Unique URI for this entity type (required)

abstract.description: Whether this entity type is abstract

singleDefaultCrosswalk.description: Limit to a single default crosswalk

matchBeforeCreate.description: Run matching before creating new entities

searchable.description: Whether this entity type is searchable

validateRequiredAttributes.description: Validate that required attributes are present

uniqueGeneratedValuePerEntityPerRequest.description: Ensure unique generated values per entity per request

ignoreNonOVChangesWhenUpdateThroughRefer.description: Ignore non-OV changes when updating through referenced entities

useOnlyOvValuesInReferencedEntities.description: Use only OV values in referenced entities

precedingCleanseProcedureUris.description: URIs of cleanse procedures to run before

succeedingCleanseProcedureUris.description: URIs of cleanse procedures to run after

entityTypeRoleURIs.description: Role URIs associated with this entity type

businessCardAttributeURIs.description: Attribute URIs shown on business cards

extendsTypeURI.description: URI of the entity type this extends

hidden.description: Hidden entity type configurations or empty / map object (live L3 / samples)

uri.description: Unique URI for this relation type (required)

reverseOfTypeURIs.description: URI of the reverse relation type

singleDefaultCrosswalk.description: Limit to a single default crosswalk

contributorCrosswalkSingleSourceUpdateMo.description: Single source update mode for contributor crosswalks

precedingCleanseProcedureUris.description: URIs of cleanse procedures to run before

succeedingCleanseProcedureUris.description: URIs of cleanse procedures to run after

extendsTypeURI.description: URI of the relation type this extends

objectTypeURI.description: URI of the object type at this endpoint

DirectionalContext.description: Directional context on a relation endpoint

rule.description: Single rule or list of rules (live L3 may use an array)

extendsTypeURI.description: URI of the role this extends

groupElements.description: Single element, array, or free-form object (live L3)

Attribute.description: Attribute definition (recursive — nested attributes contain further Attribute objects)

type.description: Attribute data type (e.g. String, Nested, Reference)

faceted.description: Whether this attribute is faceted for search

system.description: Whether this is a system attribute

matchFieldURIsIgnoreCase.description: Ignore case for match field URIs

keyAttributeURIsIgnoreCase.description: Ignore case for key attribute URIs

relationshipTypeURI.description: URI of the relationship type (reference attributes)

referencedEntityTypeURI.description: URI of the referenced entity type (reference attributes)

skipInDataAccess.description: Skip this attribute in data access queries

immutableForSources.description: Sources for which this attribute is immutable

immutableExceptForSources.description: Sources for which this attribute is NOT immutable

doNotOverrideForSourceURIs.description: Source URIs that should not override this attribute

matchFieldURIsExactOrNull.description: Match field URIs with exact-or-null semantics

matchFieldURIsExactOrAllNull.description: Match field URIs with exact-or-all-null semantics

keyAttributeURIsExactOrNull.description: Key attribute URIs with exact-or-null semantics

keyAttributeURIsExactOrAllNull.description: Key attribute URIs with exact-or-all-null semantics

autoGenerationNestedPattern.description: MapEntry list or free-form object (live L3)

InteractionAttribute.description: Interaction attribute definition (recursive for nested interaction attributes)

maskMatched.description: Whether to mask the matched portion (true) or the unmatched portion (false)

MatchRule.description: Match rule (recursive — or/and/not contain further MatchRule objects)

cleanse.description: Null, URI string, single inline cleanse, or list of cleanse steps (live L3)

weights.description: Single weight object or list (live L3)

actionThresholds.description: Single threshold object or list (live L3)

NegativeMatchRule.description: Negative match rule (recursive — or/and contain further NegativeMatchRule objects)

weight.description: Weight as string or number (live L3)

threshold.description: Threshold as string or number (live L3)

cleanseAdapterParams.description: MapEntry list or free-form object (live L3 match-rule cleanse)

MatchComparatorTokenParameterValue.description: Comparator / match-token parameter value (extends beyond MapEntry; live L3). Unknown keys allowed per schema-alignment-with-live-l3 design D4.

classParams.description: Comparator params object or array of parameter blocks (live L3)

SurvivorshipMapping.description: Survivorship mapping (recursive — fallbackStrategies contain further SurvivorshipMapping objects)

lookupComparisonField.description: Array of URIs, single string, or object map (live L3)

SurvivorshipFilter.description: Survivorship filter with comparison operators and logical composition

params.description: MapEntry list or free-form object map (live L3)

filter.description: Optional cleanse chain filter expression (live L3)

providerOpts.description: MapEntry list or free-form object (live L3)

entityTypeURIs.description: Single entity type URI or list (live L3)
